ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Cases
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trails behind recent fraud cases in Minnesota, including the welfare fraud case and any potential connections to other entities or programs.
questions: What are the sources of funding for these fraud schemes?
Are there any connections to other cases or entities?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to uncover larger patterns or connections between entities. This could lead to a more comprehensive understanding of the fraud landscape in Minnesota.
